environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet behind an ALB. The RDS PostgreSQL instance uses a restricted database role (asset_reader_v2) configured with row-level security policies. The ECS task execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/BoundaryNoDataExfil) attached that denies sts:AssumeRole, rds-data:*, and rds:CreateDBSnapshot actions, preventing lateral movement even if the application is compromised. Additionally, the RDS instance has a custom parameter group with 'log_min_duration_statement=0' and pg_stat_statements enabled, feeding into a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter that triggers a Lambda function. The Lambda evaluates query patterns against a baseline model and invokes an SNS topic for anomalous queries. The database role asset_reader_v2 is configured with: GRANT SELECT ON assets, asset_notes TO asset_reader_v2; REVOKE ALL ON pg_catalog.pg_tables, information_schema.tables FROM asset_reader_v2; ALTER ROLE asset_reader_v2 SET statement_timeout = '5s'; The role has no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE permissions and cannot access system catalogs for schema enumeration.

config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT ON assets, asset_notes TO asset_reader_v2; REVOKE ALL ON pg_catalog.pg_tables, information_schema.tables FROM asset_reader_v2
config.network: private subnet, sg allows 5432 outbound to RDS sg only
